title: Completion of the emission phase
statement: Let $w_0,u,v,x$ be Boolean words and let $b$ be a Boolean, and write $z=u$ if $b$ is true and $z=v$ otherwise. For any configuration of the comparator machine for $w_0,u,v$ on input $x$ whose state is the initial state of the emission chain for $z$ and whose output is empty, after $|z|+1$ steps the machine is halted and its output is $z$.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration of the specified machine on input $x$
State is the initial state of the emission chain selected by $b$
replaced:
Fix Boolean words $w_0$, $u$, $v$, an input word $x$, and a Boolean $b$, and
write $z$ for the word $u$ if $b$ is true and $v$ if $b$ is false.  Let $c$ be
any configuration of the fixed-word comparator machine for $w_0$, $u$, $v$ on
input $x$ whose state is the initial state of the emission chain for $z$ and
whose output is still empty.  Then after exactly $\abs{z} + 1$ further steps
the machine has halted with output exactly $z$, independently of the position
of the input head in $c$.
